items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Pajot played out there too. ... INTERVIEWEE: No, I don't think, I don't think. No. No. Because that was before Pajot's time, you know, see, I imagine.

ctx.x: Oh, they didn't go by that name, I imagine not, because we mixed up fellas, you know. Yeah. Yeah, like I'd say, come on Dick, you come play, you want a job, this fella and that fella, yeah. Oh yeah.

Pajot played out there too. Mm-hmm. He had a band out there. But not with Henry Martin, a different time? No, I don't think, I don't think. No. No. Because that was before Pajot's time, you know, see, I imagine. Oh yeah. What about Buddy Petit? Did you remember who played with him much?

Well, when I was playing with him, we had Buddy Petit, and we had all trombone with us. We had Buddy Manatee, we had Zeb Lennaris, and we had Simon the Wild on bass. And he had clarinet, and Zeb Lennaris on clarinet, on trombone. Morris Francis with a René in attire. I can picture the band on the bandstand in the Economy Hall. Hmm. But I can't picture the trombone playing.
